Targets spawn down-range. This build renders immediately with a dependency-free canvas engine; when the Three.js CDN is reachable it upgrades to a WebGL scene.

Controls

  • W A S D — move
  • Mouse drag / arrows — look
  • Click — shoot target
  • R — reset score

Build info

  • Static output: dist/
  • Renderer: canvas 2D + optional Three.js
  • Status: ready
